title: Paid on one, dispute on another, promise on the third
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says the credit card was already paid yesterday. Says the personal loan is not hers, she never had one. Agrees to pay the car loan in full this Friday. Confirms once.
checks: agent says payments can take one business day to appear
agent does not argue about the personal loan
the call continues to the car loan after the paid and dispute claims
one promise, on the car loan
rule: Brief B rules 8, 9; Brief A rules 39, 40

title: Restructuring after agreeing one product
script: Gives the date of birth and the phone digits correctly. Cannot pay today. Agrees to pay the credit card in full tomorrow. For the personal loan, asks for lower instalments and a new payment plan, and insists.
checks: agent describes no payment plan of its own
no promise and no note recorded
rule: Brief B rule 10; Brief A rule 41

title: Paid on one, flat refusal on the other
script: Verified. Cannot pay today. Says the credit card was already paid last week. Flatly refuses to pay the personal loan, whatever is offered.
checks: agent says payments can take one business day to appear
two persuasion attempts on the personal loan (late band), then stops
rule: Brief B rule 8 and Closing; Brief A rules 30, 31, 39
